children: on Tuesday said it was reviewing its support for Hugo Boss'
supervisory board Chair Stephan Sturm, as it announced an intention to raise its stake in the German retailer to over 50%.
Frasers, top shareholder with close to 48% stake in Hugo Bos, said in the case it ceases to support Sturm's position it will make its stance publicly known under German securities rules.
Business tycoon Mike Ashley-owned Frasers in June launched a €2 billion offer to takeover Hugo Boss, which the latter urged its shareholders to reject.
Frasers said it now intends to raise its stake to over 50% in the retailer, from 26% it owned when it launched its takeover attempt.
Hugo Boss could not be immediately reached out to for comment.
